recoveryGuidance.keychainUI: Apple documents that Lock keychain / Command-L does not work for login or iCloud keychains. Disabled Close login is not a reliable authentication-state test. No read-only UI operation found that guarantees the needed unlock prompt.
recoveryGuidance.firstUserControlledOption: Save work and restart/log out and back into macOS normally, then recheck the existing identity with a minimal local signature before rebuilding. This is a recovery attempt, not a proven fix. No action was performed by the diagnostic task.
recoveryGuidance.explicitUnlockOption: Apple DTS documents interactive security unlock-keychain from the user’s own Terminal; if chosen, enter any credential only into the local hidden prompt, never into chat or command arguments. Do not use -p, -u, guessed passwords, reset keychain, ACL edits, or key export.
recoveryGuidance.ifUserDoesNotWantLocalAuthentication: Keep signing blocked with prepared build artifacts. No supported password-free bypass was established.

sources.claim: Lock keychain shortcut does not work for login or iCloud keychains.
Apple DTS code-signing diagnosis recommends interactive Terminal tests and unlock-keychain; errSecInternalComponent has multiple causes.

userClarification: The user unlocks the Mac with Touch ID and has not confirmed knowing the login password. Do not restart or log out until they can authenticate after startup.
